reviews.body:
Thanks @pcbeingused333, nice catch that a citation with no `uri` dereferenced a nil pointer, and only adding the `Citations:` header when at least one source survives is the right touch.

One thing before this can go in: `golangci-lint` fails on the new test. `pkg/ai/googlegenai_test.go` line 64 ignores the error from `fmt.Fprint` (errcheck). `_, _ = fmt.Fprint(w, ...)` is enough to clear it.

The fix itself looks right to me, and build and tests are green at `6a1b8bc`. Push the lint fix and I'll approve.

Thanks for the quick lint fix, `golangci-lint` is green now and the code is approved.

Last thing: DCO fails on the new commit (`1ced8aa`) because it has no `Signed-off-by` line. `git commit --amend -s --no-edit` and a force-push to your branch sorts it, and then I'll sign off for merge.
